decisive_items: 4-week history of dry cough and mild weight loss
multifocal consolidations in the right upper lobe extending to the right lower lobe
response.rationale: Persistent symptoms despite antibiotics, negative TB workup, and imaging showing multifocal consolidations favor lung cancer; sarcoidosis is less specific without typical findings.

rejected.why: No improvement after two antibiotic courses contradicts pneumonia.
Negative AFB, Xpert, and cultures contradict active tuberculosis.
Lacks typical sarcoidosis features such as hilar adenopathy or granuloma evidence.
